name: @scout-for-lol/desktop
description: Pure-Rust desktop observer for Scout, with a gpui-kit window and an egui fallback

scripts.test: mise exec -- cargo test --workspace --all-features --locked && SCOUT_DESKTOP_PROFILE=stable mise exec -- cargo test --workspace --all-features --locked && bun --no-install --bun vitest --config ../../../../vitest.config.ts run scripts
scripts.lint: mise exec -- cargo fmt --all -- --check && mise exec -- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings && SCOUT_DESKTOP_PROFILE=stable mise exec -- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings
scripts.package:stable: SCOUT_DESKTOP_PROFILE=stable mise exec -- cargo packager --release --config packaging/stable.json
scripts.package:beta: SCOUT_DESKTOP_PROFILE=beta mise exec -- cargo packager --release --config packaging/beta.json
